F_T320_03.cause: INHERITED OFFSET: T-233 applied the p.13 TYPICAL isolated-footing projection 0.10 (projection_m 0.1 for all 26 outlines) to FF, whose governing detail is p.14 (lift with isolated footing): p.14 prints the blinding thickness ('10cm Plain con.') and draws the blinding beyond the side membrane + protection board, with NO projection dimension. T-170's HELD is the correct reading.

closure.z1_note: T-320 Z1 holds every FF component (below-EG share depends on the unprinted pit depth); this ledger moves no value into Z1: residual 0.000. Its FF blinding hold changes basis: 0 .. 2.256 (T-233 offset) -> HELD, AT_LEAST 2.070 if wholly below EG, upper end not printed.
